recorded_modeling_limitations: The parameter source's +0.43 symmetry correction applies to self-complementary duplexes. dsRIP applies the table to 4 bp sub-regions of a 19 bp helix, where a 4-mer's self-complementarity has no physical meaning. This affects 16 of the 256 keys and can shift a score by +/-0.43 kcal/mol. Retained unmodified for source fidelity for fidelity to the published implementation.
The table is fixed at 37 C while dsRIP's separate folding features accept a user temperature (default 25 C in its code). The asymmetry component therefore carries a fixed 37 C assumption.
The underlying efficacy associations were calibrated in Tribolium castaneum. Transfer to Dalbulus maidis and to Maize rayado fino virus is an assumption of the project plan, not a finding.
The table covers only fully Watson-Crick 4-mers. This is sufficient because the modeled siRNA duplex core is perfectly complementary by construction, so no mismatch or GU wobble can arise.
